name: max-design
description: Production-minded UI/UX design skills for AI coding agents, covering frontend design, design systems, accessibility, motion, and design review.

skills.name: accessibility-audit
skills.description: Audit and improve interface accessibility across semantics, keyboard use, focus, forms, contrast, zoom, touch, and reduced-motion behavior.

skills.name: data-visualization
skills.description: Select, design, label, and verify charts and data displays that help users interpret evidence accurately and accessibly.

skills.name: design-review
skills.description: Critique an implemented interface using evidence-based findings prioritized by user impact, severity, scope, and practical remediation.

skills.name: design-system
skills.description: Audit, document, create, and safely extend a product design system with semantic tokens, component rules, themes, and migration guidance.

skills.name: forms-ux
skills.description: Design accessible, resilient forms and multi-step input flows with sensible validation, clear errors, preserved data, and safe submission behavior.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.description: Design and implement distinctive, polished, responsive frontend interfaces with production-quality hierarchy, realistic content, working states, and maintainable code.

skills.name: information-architecture
skills.description: Plan and improve navigation, information hierarchy, page structure, findability, and task flows around real user goals.

skills.name: interaction-motion
skills.description: Design purposeful micro-interactions, transitions, feedback states, and responsive motion that clarify behavior without harming accessibility or performance.

skills.name: max-design
skills.description: Coordinate end-to-end product interface work with context discovery, visual direction, specialist workflows, implementation, critique, and evidence-based verification.

skills.name: resilient-localization
skills.description: Harden interfaces against slow networks, unexpected data, long text, localization, right-to-left layouts, and recoverable failures.

skills.name: ui-testing
skills.description: Build practical UI verification plans for interactions, responsive layouts, accessibility, visual regression, and real-world edge cases.

skills.name: ux-writing-content
skills.description: Write clear, consistent interface copy for navigation, buttons, forms, onboarding, empty states, errors, confirmations, and notifications.
